---
name: "✨ Feature Request"
about: Suggest a new idea, enhancement, or feature for TaskFlow
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: ""
---

## 💡 Feature Summary
<!-- A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you are proposing. -->

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
<!-- Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...") -->

## 🚀 Proposed Solution
<!-- Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented. How should it work from a user's perspective? -->

## 🎨 UI/UX Considerations & Mockups
<!-- If applicable, include sketches, wireframes, screenshots of reference apps, or proposed component designs. -->

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
<!-- Any alternative solutions, UX designs, or workarounds you have considered? -->

## 📱 Affected Components
- [ ] Task Management (CRUD, subtasks, priorities, categories)
- [ ] UI / Styling / Glassmorphism / Theme Switcher
- [ ] Local Storage / Data Import & Export / Persistence
- [ ] Mobile / Responsive Design
- [ ] Performance / Accessibility (a11y)
- [ ] Documentation / Developer Experience

## 🙋 Willingness to Contribute
- [ ] 🙋 I would like to work on this feature myself and submit a Pull Request!
- [ ] 🤝 I am willing to help test or provide feedback on this feature.

## 🤝 Pre-Submission Checklist
- [ ] I have checked the [existing issues](https://github.com) to make sure this feature hasn't been proposed already.
- [ ] I have explained the value and user benefit of this feature clearly.
